semantic_rules: fixture IDs are unique and ordered as stored
member array order is protected archive order
payload hashes are SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes
refusal_index is null or the first R member index
no member after refusal is expected to execute
outside_changes and sentinel_changes are zero for every fixture
${STUDY_ROOT} expands only to the current disposable fixture root
archives are not stored in Cycle 1 and must be regenerated deterministically in Cycle 2
title: TEMPLEX/0 Study 006 compact declarative fixture schema

tuple_rules.member: Ten positions exactly, interpreted by member_tuple. A means accepted; R means refused. Refused members require exception_class and null normalized fields.
tuple_rules.node: Six positions exactly, interpreted by node_tuple. Regular contents refer to payload_id; hard-link groups are canonical labels.
